title: Scalar square for the completed tensor at one finite source stage
statement: Fix a prime l and a scheme X on whose residue fields l is invertible. Fix a normalized native realization R of [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-realization-data], a closed tensor closed with its K-flat models models, and the normalized finite model convention of [def-sf-adic-completed-tensor-finite-models]. Let E ≤ F be finite coefficient fields inside PadicAlgCl l, NE and NF finite tensor models at these fields, and K,L two raw rational constructible objects at E in the categories of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Write I for the inclusion of E into the common-stage category and a,b for the actual isoToStage maps of [def-weil-pbc-finite-stage-pair-category] from I(K),I(L) to F. Then the closed tensor of ordinary(a),ordinary(b), followed by completedTensorStageComponent at F on their transitions, equals completedTensorStageComponent at E on K,L, followed by the ordinary realization of the common tensor of a,b. The stage components are precisely those of [def-sf-adic-completed-tensor-stage-component]. Only the two models and a pair at a single source coefficient field occur.

source.place: BS Definition 3.4.10 and Remark 6.8.15; HRS Proposition 5.2 and Lemma 7.9; the corresponding part of the finite normalized realization argument.

proof.text: Choose good integral K-flat representatives of the two objects at E. Insert the representative equations of NE and NF, the normalized whole completion coaugmentations, and the finite-free completed scalar comparison. Use coefficient_scalar and balanced ordinary scalar associativity: both routes on a homogeneous generator send s tensor (x tensor y) to (s tensor x) tensor (1 tensor y). Sheafification and total coproduct inclusions give equality of the whole chain maps; the shifted completion coordinate is zero. Pass through derived localization and cancel the invertible K-flat counits and constructible completion comparisons. R.common_field identifies the boundary maps. The normalized integral tensor scalar comparison, its rationalization, and the common-stage tensor representative formula identify the output boundary. The normalized stageTensor formula is the component of commonInclusionTensorComparison. This is precisely the two-field scalar square, including identity extensions.

proof_origin.place: BS Definition 3.4.10 and Remark 6.8.15; HRS Proposition 5.2 and Lemma 7.9; the corresponding part of the finite normalized realization argument.
proof_origin.note: U9: the two-field normalized representative square from the parent plan. The compositum definition, endpoint associator corrections, and their naturality are proved separately in the parent.

lean.statement:
theorem completedTensorStageComponent_scalar
    (E F : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l (PadicAlgCl l)) (h : E ≤ F)
    (NE : CompletedTensorFiniteModel l X R closed models E)
    (NF : CompletedTensorFiniteModel l X R closed models F)
    (K L : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l
      (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X) :
    let I := GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
      (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := X) E
    let a := (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l
      (PadicAlgCl l) X).isoToStage (I.obj K) h
    let b := (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l
      (PadicAlgCl l) X).isoToStage (I.obj L) h
    (((ordinary l X R).prod (ordinary l X R)) ⋙ closed.tensor).map
        (Prod.mkHom a.hom b.hom) ≫
      (completedTensorStageComponent l X R closed models F NF
        ((I.obj K).toStage h) ((I.obj L).toStage h)).hom =
    (completedTensorStageComponent l X R closed models E NE K L).hom ≫
      (commonStageDerivedTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) X ⋙ ordinary l X R).map
        (Prod.mkHom a.hom b.hom)
